question.problem: The average temperature in the Arctic in December of a particular year was ${3.2}^{∘}\,\text{C}.$ Due to plummeting temperatures in the winter, the average temperature in February of the next year decreased by ${6.9}^{∘}\,\text{C}$ compared to the average temperature in December. What was the average temperature in the Arctic in February?

current_example.problem: Luisa has an overdraft facility authorized by her bank. Her bank balance on Monday was $\[math] 173.25.$ On Tuesday, Luisa decided to withdraw $\[/math] 250.70$ to buy a laptop. What is Luisa's bank balance at the end of the day on Tuesday?
current_example.worked_solution:
To find Luisa's bank balance at the end of the day on Tuesday, we subtract the amount of money Luisa spent on the laptop from the starting balance, as follows:

$$
\[math] 173.25 - \[/math] 250.70 = -\[math] 77.45
$$

Therefore, Luisa's bank balance at the end of the day on Tuesday was $-\[/math] 77.45.$
